fields.label: AI Provider
fields.description: Select the AI provider used by the AI Engineer agent. Changing this setting does not change the agent tools or ERPNext codebase logic.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Provider model ID. Examples: claude-sonnet-5, gemini-3.7-flash, moonshotai/kimi-k2.6, gpt-5.6-luna.

fields.label: Anthropic API Key
fields.description: API key for the Anthropic Claude API.

fields.label: Google AI API Key
fields.description: API key created in Google AI Studio for the Gemini API.

fields.label: NVIDIA API Key
fields.description: Existing NVIDIA Developer API key for the hosted NIM endpoint.

fields.label: OpenAI API Key
fields.description: API key for the OpenAI API.

fields.label: Anthropic Base URL
fields.description: Normally leave this at the official Anthropic API endpoint.

fields.label: Google Gemini Base URL
fields.description: Normally leave this at the Google Gemini API endpoint.

fields.label: NVIDIA NIM Base URL
fields.description: Base URL for NVIDIA NIM. Existing Base URL values are retained for backward compatibility.

fields.label: OpenAI Base URL
fields.description: Normally leave this at the official OpenAI API endpoint.

fields.label: Legacy Base URL
fields.description: Compatibility field retained from the original NVIDIA-only AI Engineer settings.

fields.label: Legacy NIM Base URL
fields.description: Compatibility field retained from earlier AI Engineer versions.

fields.label: Temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature. Some models, including current Claude reasoning models, ignore or reject custom sampling parameters; the provider adapter handles this safely.

fields.label: Allow Code Execution
fields.description: Required for agent validation commands. Keep disabled until you trust the generated code and environment.

fields.label: Allowed Commands
fields.default:
python -m compileall
python -m pytest
ruff check
bench --version

fields.label: Workspace Root
fields.description: Optional path under the bench directory for generated projects. Leave blank to use sites/<site>/private/ai_engineer.
